name: 70706 · Denham Spgs, LA
findings: ZIP 70706 (Denham Spgs) has 42 nonprofit organizations. 13 of them (31%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 11 organizations.
Social and fraternal organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (67% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 70706 (Denham Spgs) has fewer organizations offering opportunities per resident.
